issues: The activated cemetery ability cost is encoded incorrectly. It should use a cemetery-banish cost object matching 'Banish this card and an Iceschillendrig, Gilded Autocrat from your cemetery', e.g. banishSelf plus banishFromCemetery with filter {"identityName":"Iceschillendrig, Gilded Autocrat"} and count 1, not a non-reference shape with separate banishCount.

The 'This card is put onto the field engaged' clause is encoded incorrectly as a passive engageSelf ability, which would repeatedly engage the card instead of applying only on entry. It should be encoded as an enters-the-field-engaged property or a dedicated enter-engaged ability; implement engine support for cards that enter the field engaged.

The Last Words effect must keep the same selected enemy follower for both clauses: destroy that follower and deal 3 damage to its leader. Replace the sequence of destroy enemy follower + deal 3 to enemy leader with a single linked effect such as damageFollowerAndLeader using followerAmount 0/linked destroy semantics or another implementation that targets one enemy follower and then damages its leader.

The spell should put a follower from your cemetery onto your field, not add it to hand. Replace tutorFromCemetery to hand/field-like tutoring with an effect that summons or revives a selected follower from your cemetery to the field, then grant Ward to that summoned follower.

The ability 'When this follower deals attack damage to an enemy leader, you win the game' is missing. Add a trigger for dealing attack damage to the enemy leader with effect winGame; implement engine support for a combat-damage-to-leader trigger if not available.

The passive winGame ability is incorrect. It should trigger only when this follower deals attack damage to an enemy leader, not continuously while on the field. Replace it with a combat-damage-to-enemy-leader trigger that resolves winGame; implement engine support for that trigger timing if missing.
